name: @idcesares/rse-design-system

--rse-brand-pink-ink.description: Derived text steps, one per accent hue (decision D2). The official -dark tones reach only 3.4–4.1:1 against both white and ink, so none can carry small text. Text only — fills, artwork, selo and motif use the official values.

--rse-brand-black.description: Official black of the marks. Logo ink and one-colour print.

--rse-brand-ink.description: UI text ink, warmer than the mark black. Carries text on every light and mid accent (4.8–10:1).

--rse-brand-gray-50.description: System neutrals, warm to sit with cream. Not in the manual.

--rse-color-sabia-purple.description: Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA palette (manual p.90): three unchanged Rede values, no colour of its own. Use only on Sab.IA surfaces and entry points. The platform chrome is BLUE, not purple — see docs/sabia-platform.md.

--rse-color-sabia-on-blue.description: Text on the blue platform chrome. White on --rse-color-sabia-blue is 2.27:1; ink is 6.17:1.

--rse-color-sabia-surface.description: Not in the manual: a system page tone for Sab.IA surfaces, which the manual does not supply.

--rse-color-text-on-primary-tint.description:
Text and icons on --rse-color-surface-primary-tint (secondary button, menu hover, avatar initials).
--rse-color-primary itself is 4.29:1 there; the hover purple is 5.29:1.

--rse-color-surface-page-translucent.description: Sticky header / any chrome that sits over scrolling page content.

--rse-color-border-subtle.description:
Three borders, and the difference is a rule, not a taste:
subtle / default are decoration — hairlines between rows, around a specimen, under a
section. They may sit below 3:1.
strong is the resting boundary of an interactive control — field, checkbox, radio, chip,
ghost button, menu trigger, step marker. Those controls fill with --rse-color-surface-card, the same
colour as the surface behind them, so the border is the only thing identifying the control
and WCAG 1.4.11 requires 3:1. --rse-color-border-default (gray-300) gave 1.61:1; gray-500 gives 3.96:1.
Never move a control's border back to --rse-color-border-default.

--rse-color-border-on-ink.description: Hairline on the fixed ink surface (footer), which stays ink in every theme.

--rse-color-text-on-ink.description: Text on the fixed ink surface (footer), which stays ink in every theme.

--rse-color-text-on-ink-muted.description: Secondary text on the ink surface: 6.0:1 against it. Never a dimmed white.

--rse-color-text-muted.description:
gray-600, not gray-500: at gray-500 this cleared only 3.56:1 on the cream page and
3.96:1 on a white card, under the 4.5:1 floor this system sets for body text — and
--rse-color-text-muted carries real body copy (card descriptions, lead paragraphs). The dark
and contrast themes override it separately and were already above the floor.

--rse-color-text-link.description: Link text. The deeper purple, not --rse-color-primary: the primary is 4.50:1 on cream and 4.44:1 on the sunken surface, this is 5.3:1 or more on every light surface.

--rse-color-success-text.description:
Status colours come in three roles. The bare name (--rse-color-success) is the INDICATOR: dots,
borders, icons, progress fills, held to 3:1 non-text contrast. Text uses the -text role,
which clears 4.5:1 on the matching -surface and on white. Never set text in the bare name:
--rse-color-warning as text is 2.17:1.

--rse-color-tint-pink.description: Accent chip tints — the pale backing behind a Tag in each of the six accent families. Paired with the matching tint-*-ink as foreground. Themed: never hard-code these values in a component.

--rse-color-tint-pink-ink.description: Text/icon colour to use on the matching tint.

--rse-container-padding.description: Page side gutter: 16px on a phone, 24px from ~600px up.

--rse-breakpoint-xs.description: Not emitted as custom properties: CSS cannot read var() inside @media. Use the literal in media queries, or read it from dist/tokens.json / dist/tokens.js. Prefer container queries for components.
